messages.content: Let’s finish Pittsburgh. Recalculate the whole weekend with the updated Schenley rate, compare it one last time with Riverfront Plaza including rides, and tell me what the two airfare tiers cost now.

For Friday, June 12 through Monday, June 15, Schenley House’s cancellable King Studio with Full Sofa Bed is now $752.46 for three nights including taxes. The hotel reconfirmed three-person occupancy at no extra charge and will prepare the sofa bed for Owen. Estimated rides are $92 for the ballpark and Science Center trips plus $118 for round-trip airport transportation, bringing lodging and local transportation to $962.46. Free cancellation ends at 11:59 p.m. local time June 9; after that, the penalty is $238.26.
And Riverfront? Use the two-queen room, not a king option.

Riverfront Plaza’s Two Queen Guest Room remains available for all three of you. The three-night room total is $864.33 including taxes and destination charges. Estimated local transportation is $22 for Sunday’s Science Center rides and $96 for airport rides, for $982.33 combined. Free cancellation ends at 6:00 p.m. local time June 10; the later penalty is $312.11.
So downtown is only about twenty dollars more once transportation is included?

Correct. Riverfront Plaza is $19.87 more on the flight-based trip. Schenley House is better positioned for the university area and Saturday’s 1:35 p.m. game, while Riverfront Plaza reduces the Science Center ride time and has two fixed beds. Schenley’s confirmed prepared sofa bed removes the sleeping-arrangement concern.
Now the flights. I saw the preferred outbound jump.

The Friday-to-Monday nonstop itinerary is still available: Chicago to Pittsburgh Friday from 8:10 a.m. to 10:42 a.m., returning Monday from 4:55 p.m. to 5:38 p.m. The lowest tier is $927 total for three travelers, with seat assignments deferred and more restrictive change terms. The standard economy tier is now $1,041 total and allows earlier seat selection. Both totals include taxes.
Give me complete totals for each hotel using standard economy. No parking, since we’re flying.

With the $1,041 standard economy airfare, Schenley House is $2,003.46: $1,041 flights, $752.46 hotel, and $210 estimated rides. Riverfront Plaza is $2,023.33: $1,041 flights, $864.33 hotel, and $118 estimated rides. Those figures exclude meals, game tickets, and Science Center admission. At the lower airfare tier, the corresponding totals would be $1,889.46 and $1,909.33.
The difference doesn’t justify moving downtown, and I’d rather be closer to the game. Book standard economy and Schenley House.

I’ll book the nonstop standard economy itinerary for Marcus Lee, Daniel Lee, and Owen Lee, plus the Schenley House King Studio with Full Sofa Bed for three nights. The hotel request will specify that the sofa bed be made up before arrival. The amount charged now is $1,793.46; the estimated $210 in rides is not prepaid.
Yes, authorize the $1,793.46. Keep the hotel cancellable.
Authorization received. I’m completing the flights at $1,041 and the cancellable hotel rate at $752.46.
Confirm everything, including the deadlines and what still isn’t paid.

The Pittsburgh weekend is confirmed for June 12-15. The nonstop standard economy flights are booked for all three travelers at $1,041 under confirmation P6T8RM: ORD-PIT Friday 8:10-10:42 a.m. and PIT-ORD Monday 4:55-5:38 p.m. Earlier seat selection is available, but seats have not yet been assigned.

Schenley House is confirmed under SH-418672 for a King Studio with Full Sofa Bed, $752.46 including taxes. Marcus, Daniel, and Owen are registered with no extra-person charge, and the sofa-bed preparation request is attached. Free cancellation ends at 11:59 p.m. Pittsburgh time on June 9; cancellation after that carries a $238.26 penalty.

The charged total is $1,793.46. Estimated rides remain unbooked and unpaid at $210: approximately $118 for airport transfers and $92 for the ballpark and Science Center trips. The complete expected weekend total is $2,003.46 before meals and admissions.
